item.title: RTT: Ref. 6286_All. 4 - Compositional and Functional Characterization and Modulation of the Gut Microbiota in Pediatric Patients Undergoing Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation and Advanced Cellular Therapies (Univ. BOLOGNA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-03 23:59
Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Bologna
Field: Medicine / 06/MEDS-20 Pediatria generale e specialistica e neuropsichiatria infantile

The gut microbiota undergoes profound alterations in pediatric patients with hematological disorders, undergoing hematopoietic stem cell transplantation or advanced cellular therapies. These changes are associated with an increased risk of complications, significantly impacting survival and quality of life. Understanding microbiota dynamics may enable the development of targeted therapeutic strategies. This project aims to: 1. characterize, through metagenomic approaches, the composition and functions of the gut microbiota in pediatric patients with hematological disorders, receiving transplantation or advanced cellular therapies, correlating them with clinical outcomes; 2. evaluate the…

item.title: RTT: Ref. 6348_All. 1 - NeuroAI-LIFE: An Artificial Intelligence-Based Predictive Platform for Cognitive and Functional Recovery and Quality of Life in Patients with Glioma (Univ. BOLOGNA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-03 23:59
Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Cesena
Field: Medicine / 06/MEDS-15 Neurochirurgia e chirurgia maxillo-facciale

NeuroAI-LIFE is a translational research project integrating neurosurgery, cognitive neuroscience, and artificial intelligence to improve recovery and quality of life in patients with glioma. The main objective is to develop predictive models able to identify patients at risk of persistent neurological deficits and support personalized treatment and rehabilitation strategies. The project combines advanced neuroimaging, neuropsychological assessments, neurophysiological monitoring, and clinical data. Machine learning algorithms will analyze these datasets to predict cognitive and functional outcomes. Expected results include the identification of neuroplasticity biomarkers, the development…
